seo.title: Massage near Scotchtown, NY | Golden Practice
seo.description: Licensed massage serving Scotchtown, NY — about 8 min from Brooklyn via Route 211. Transparent pricing, open every day.

richText.body: Scotchtown is practically next door — about eight minutes south on Route 211, our closest neighborhood of all. It's the easiest trip in the area, whether you're squeezing in a quick reflexology session or settling in for a full ninety-minute massage.
